summary: The dbx-components demo stack: the demo-api dev MCP (demo-api-mcp-dev) on :9901, served by the dockerized Firebase emulators

offerings.title: demo-api dev MCP (:9901)
offerings.description: The demo-api app's MCP endpoint (demo-api-mcp-dev in .mcp.json, http://localhost:9901/mcp): the compact demo_* call-model tools over the guestbook/profile sample models, against the local Firebase emulators. Served by the demo-api-server docker container under the dbx-claude serve supervisor (demo-api:build-watch), so it restarts on every demo-api rebuild. OAuth-guarded; the browser login leg needs ./serve-web.sh (:9010). Free and local.
requires: Docker, with the demo-api-server container served through dbx-claude (dbx-claude serve server)
./serve-web.sh (the demo app on :9010) for the OAuth login leg of /mcp → Authenticate
